svg.title: TrainPipelineSparseDist: one steady-state progress()
svg.desc: Host submission order, not a measured timeline. Batch i is the current training batch. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. Entry: i has a tensors request; i+1 has been copied. Default enqueue placement is shown. zero_grad(i); join prior data_dist work data_dist waits for the copy of i+1 start_sparse_data_dist(i+1): launch split AllToAll Submit split-size AllToAll; compatible metadata requests may be fused by process group. enqueue_batch(i+2): nonblocking device copy Forward of batch i model(i) reaches PipelinedForward Second wait for i: finish payload / reconstruct KJT Consumes payload and reconstructs the KJT; uncached, nonempty CUDA lengths in the fixed-stride path require D2H and current-stream synchronization. Training stream waits for data_dist; record_stream Lookup(i), output AllToAll(i), downstream forward(i) Composite compute stage including an embedding collective; the whole bar is not NCCL execution time. After forward returns to the host wait_sparse_data_dist(i+1): host reads splits; launch payload Read receive sizes onto the host (D2H + stream synchronization), allocate buffers, then launch lengths and ID values AllToAll. backward(i), reverse embedding AllToAll(i), optimizer(i) Composite compute stage including an embedding collective; the whole bar is not NCCL execution time. Payload(i+1) can overlap GPU backward(i); no independent cache-prefetch stage. dequeue i; retain matching batches / contexts for i+1 and i+2
